prompt:
Website page design comp, desktop landscape, of the "Volunteer" page of Beauty From Ashes Surgical Ministry, a Christian nonprofit offering reconstructive surgery free or at reduced cost. The visitor is a surgeon, anesthesiologist, nurse or other clinician who wants to know exactly what joining involves. Show the first viewport.
LAYOUT, top to bottom:
1. Header (see below), current page "Volunteer".
2. Two columns. LEFT column (about 38% width, stays in place while the right scrolls): large serif headline "Serve with your skills." then a sans paragraph "Surgeons, anesthesia providers, nurses and surgical teams give their time so patients who can't afford surgery still receive excellent care. Here is how you join." then an italic serif line "Medical and non-medical volunteers are both welcome." then the cobalt brushed button "Volunteer your skills".
3. THE FOCAL MOMENT, RIGHT column: five numbered steps, each with a large italic serif numeral at left, a serif step name and a sans line of what it involves, separated by hand-brushed cobalt rules exactly like the reference's numbered steps: "1 Tell us about you" / "Share your role, your license and when you could serve."; "2 A conversation" / "We talk about where your skills fit and answer your questions."; "3 Credentialing" / "We verify your license and run a background check."; "4 Orientation" / "Learn how a surgery day runs and how we care for patients."; "5 Your first surgery day" / "Serve alongside the team, then decide how often you'd like to return."

VISUAL WORLD (identical to the reference images, which show the ministry's existing home page): a buff salt-glazed stoneware page ground (#d8d1c4) with a fine orange-peel texture across the whole page; iron-brown serif type (a warm book serif, regular weight only, never bold) for headings, buttons, links and quotations; a soft humanist sans in dark clay brown for body text; small spaced capitals in soft iron brown as section labels; cobalt blue (#0b3d9c) used ONLY for actions and hand-brushed strokes. Primary buttons are cobalt swatches with dry-brushed ragged edges and a white serif label. Secondary buttons are hand-inked iron-brown outline frames with an iron serif label. Text links are cobalt serif with a short hand-brushed cobalt underline stroke. Flat surfaces: no cards, no boxes, no panels, no drop shadows, no icons, no rounded corners, no gradients. Sections separate with generous space, thin iron hairlines, and occasional hand-brushed cobalt rules. Unhurried, dignified, warm, professional.
HEADER (exactly as in the reference): at left the wordmark "Beauty From Ashes" in serif with "SURGICAL MINISTRY" in small spaced capitals beneath it; nav links in serif: "Get Help", "Volunteer", "Partner", "Stories", "About"; at right "EN | ES" in small sans and a cobalt brushed "Give" button; a full-width hand-brushed cobalt rule runs under the header. The nav link "Volunteer" has a short hand-brushed cobalt stroke under it marking the current page.
The reference images contribute the header, palette, ground texture, typography, buttons and brush strokes. Do NOT copy their content: no stoneware jar, no "Restoring more than what can be seen" headline, no mission quotation, no values row.
Render a crisp, legible website design comp at desktop width with every word spelled exactly as given. No lorem ipsum, no statistics, no photographs of people, no stock imagery.
